tools.name: check_vat_id
tools.description: Checks one EU VAT ID (27 member states plus XI) or one Swiss UID live in the official register (VIES or the Swiss UID register). Returns valid / invalid / unavailable / format_error, the registered name and address where published, the source with the time of the check (UTC) and a ready-to-file reco

tools.name: check_vat_ids
tools.description: Checks up to 20 EU VAT IDs and/or Swiss UIDs live in the official registers. Returns one result per number in the same order, plus a summary count. Duplicates are looked up once.

tools.name: validate_vat_format
tools.description: Offline check of format and check digit for up to 100 EU VAT IDs or Swiss UIDs, without contacting any register. Fast and unlimited. It cannot tell whether a number is registered; use check_vat_id for that.

tools.name: vies_status
tools.description: Shows which EU member state services in VIES are currently available. Use it when a check returned 'unavailable' to see whether the national service is down.

tools.name: find_swiss_company
tools.description: Searches the public Swiss UID register by company name (optionally with postal code or town) and returns up to 10 matches with UID, name, address and VAT registration status. Use it when the user knows a Swiss company's name but not its UID.

tools.name: check_eori
tools.description: Checks up to 10 EU EORI customs numbers (incl. XI) live in the European Commission's EOS validation service. Returns registered / not registered, and name and address where the holder agreed to publish them. GB EORI numbers are not supported.

tools.name: find_peppol_participant
tools.description: Looks up whether a company can receive e-invoices via Peppol. Search by VAT ID (the usual Peppol identifiers are derived automatically), by a known Peppol participant ID, or by company name. tools.name: find_lei
tools.description: Looks up a company's LEI in the GLEIF database: by LEI code (with entity status, registration status, BIC and direct and ultimate parent company) or by company name (possible matches, optionally filtered by country).

tools.name: check_business_partner
tools.description: One report on a business partner before invoicing or delivering: VAT ID (VIES or Swiss UID register), EORI customs number (the given one, or the VAT ID tried as EORI), Peppol e-invoicing reachability, and LEI with parent company. tools.name: check_iban
tools.description: Use for one or several IBANs when no BIC is given. With a BIC, use check_payment_details. Offline check of up to 20 IBANs: format, length for the country and check digits. Optionally compares the account's country with the partner's country (argument partner: a country code or the partner's VAT ID)

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Returns the European Central Bank's euro reference rate for a currency on a given date (or the last rate before it, on weekends and holidays), and optionally converts an amount to or from euro. Use it for invoices in foreign currency.

tools.name: check_payment_details
tools.description: Use when an IBAN comes together with a BIC (SWIFT code). For IBANs without a BIC, use check_iban.
